column3: While Bill hunted the deer was hunted by Bill.
While Bill hunted the deer that was brown and nimble was hunted by Bill.
While Mary bathed the baby bathed Mary.
While Mary bathed the baby that was small and cute bathed Mary.
Anna scolded the chef of the aristocrats who was routinely letting food go to waste.
Anna studied with the chef of the aristocrats who was routinely letting food go to waste.
While Susan dressed the baby played on the floor.
While Susan dressed the baby that was happy and loud played on the floor.
